request.description: Initiates the deposit hold for a PENDING reservation via App\Http\Controllers\Api\V1\PaymentController::hold. Requires the payments.manage permission (Group Owner / assigned Hotel Manager) and access to the reservation's hotel. Body validated by StorePaymentHoldRequest: amount (required decimal string, positive, fits DECIMAL(12,2)); currency (optional 3-letter ISO code, never defaulted). Idempotency is HTTP-header based: repeating the same Idempotency-Key for the same reservation replays the existing result without a second provider call. 201 = hold active + reservation DEPOSIT_HELD; 200 = provider still processing (payment HOLD_REQUESTED); 422 = declined / cancelled / expired hold or a validation/business error. No simulation directive is accepted in production.

Provider async callback (PaymentWebhookController::handle). UNAUTHENTICATED machine-to-machine: the HMAC-SHA256 signature over the EXACT raw body (X-Signature header, computed by the pre-request script from {{payment_webhook_secret}} - set it to match PAYMENT_DUMMY_WEBHOOK_SECRET) is the credential. Reuses the Phase 5C result-application logic. HTTP: 400 invalid/missing signature (nothing persisted); 422 malformed / wrong shape / missing type / sensitive-key payload; 200 for every valid delivery (processed | duplicate_ignored | unmatched). Deduped by provider event_id, or by payload hash when event_id is absent; duplicate and post-resolution deliveries never re-apply a transition. Rate limited (throttle:payments.webhook). To exercise: run '09 Payments > Payment Hold' first with X-Payment-Simulate: pending (local/testing only), then send this with that transaction's provider_reference.

item.name: 10 Identity Verification
item.description: Phase 6 - Identity Verification (dummy provider). Endpoints per Phase 0 §16: /api/v1/identity-verification/{reservation}/{documents|selfie|status|review}. {reservation} is an int id resolved through ReservationService (not route-model binding), so a cross-hotel or missing id is an identical plain 404. Permissions: identity-verification.view / .submit / .review — held by Group Owner, assigned Hotel Manager, and assigned Reception (Phase 0 §7: Reception may review/decide a pending verification). Guest-role users have none and are resolved out of scope (404). Confidence thresholds and the retry limit are genuinely-unresolved business values (Phase 0 §20 items 2/3/5) - config('verification.*') is UNSET by default and the workflow then fails safe to PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW (never auto-approve / never auto-reject). The X-Identity-Simulate header (high_match | medium_match | low_match | error) is honoured ONLY in local/testing.

request.description: IdentityVerificationController::documents. Multipart form-data: document (required file, mimes jpg/jpeg/png/pdf, max config('verification.storage.max_file_kb') KB); document_type (optional short label, never a document number). Creates the verification session on first use (the reservation must be DEPOSIT_HELD), starts a new attempt from NOT_STARTED / RETRY_ALLOWED / STAFF_REJECTED (subject to config('verification.max_retries')), or replaces the document on the current DOCUMENT_UPLOADED attempt. The file is stored on a PRIVATE disk and never served back. 201 = session status document_uploaded. 422 = reservation not DEPOSIT_HELD, retry limit reached, wrong session state, or validation error.

exec: pm.test('No storage path or provider internals exposed', () => {

header.description: local/testing only: high_match | medium_match | low_match | error

request.description: IdentityVerificationController::selfie. Multipart form-data: selfie (required file, mimes jpg/jpeg/png). Transitions DOCUMENT_UPLOADED -> SELFIE_CAPTURED -> MATCHING_IN_PROGRESS, then calls IdentityVerificationProviderInterface::verify OUTSIDE any DB transaction, then applies the normalized result against config('verification.thresholds'). Idempotency is HTTP-header based: repeating the same Idempotency-Key replays the stored result without a second provider call. 200 with data.status one of: auto_approved (reservation DEPOSIT_HELD -> VERIFIED via ReservationService), pending_manual_review (score below the auto-approve threshold, or that threshold unset), or retry_allowed (provider error, retry budget remaining). 422 = selfie submitted before a document / wrong session state / validation error.

exec: pm.test('No storage path / provider reference leaked', () => {

request.description: IdentityVerificationController::status. Requires identity-verification.view. Returns the session's safe fields only: status, provider, attempts, latest_outcome, latest_score, decided_at, and a compact latest_decision block (result, band, staff reason, decided_by_user_id, decided_at). When no session exists yet the response is a transient 'not_started' payload (HTTP 200), never a 404. Storage paths, provider references and attempt metadata are never included.

IdentityVerificationController::review. Requires identity-verification.review (Group Owner / assigned Hotel Manager / assigned Reception). Valid ONLY when the session is PENDING_MANUAL_REVIEW. Body: decision (required: approve | reject); reason (optional short staff note, max 500, not a place for PII). approve -> STAFF_APPROVED and, if the reservation is still DEPOSIT_HELD, DEPOSIT_HELD -> VERIFIED via ReservationService. reject -> STAFF_REJECTED (reservation left as-is; a retry is possible from STAFF_REJECTED only while under config('verification.max_retries')). 422 = session not pending_manual_review / no session / validation error. Every decision is appended to identity_verification_decisions and audited.

item.name: 11 Check-in & Digital Access
item.description: Phase 7 - Check-in + Digital Access (dummy provider). Endpoints per Phase 0 §16: /api/v1/check-in/{reservation}, /api/v1/access/{reservation}, /api/v1/access/{reservation}/revoke. {reservation} is an int id resolved through ReservationService (not route-model binding), so a cross-hotel or missing id is an identical plain 404. Permissions: check-in.perform / digital-access.view / digital-access.revoke - held by Group Owner, assigned Hotel Manager, and assigned Reception (Phase 0 §7: Reception issues/revokes access as 'manual-assist, logged'). Guest-role users have none and are resolved out of scope (404). Check-in issues the digital access credential (staged: DB txn -> provider call OUTSIDE any txn -> DB txn) and, on an ACTIVE credential, drives the reservation VERIFIED -> CHECKED_IN via ReservationService (Phase 0 §8 '(access issued)'). Eligibility (§8/§11): reservation VERIFIED + Payment HOLD_ACTIVE + identity approved + the stay not over. Access expiry is derived from the reservation's check_out date (§11 'stay end reached') - no configurable duration. The X-Digital-Access-Simulate header (success | failure) is honoured ONLY in local/testing. The PIN is returned ONLY while the grant is ACTIVE and is encrypted at rest.

request.description: CheckInController::store -> DigitalAccessService::checkIn. No body. Validates the §8/§11 eligibility rules, issues the credential through DigitalAccessProviderInterface OUTSIDE any DB transaction, and on an ACTIVE credential transitions VERIFIED -> CHECKED_IN via ReservationService. Idempotency is HTTP-header based: repeating the same Idempotency-Key replays the stored grant without a second provider call. 201 = credential active + reservation CHECKED_IN (data.credential is the PIN). 422 = reservation not VERIFIED / payment hold not active / identity not approved / stay window passed / provider failure (data.errors.status = failed - check-in can be retried). Rate limited (throttle:check-in). NEVER triggers a refund or cancellation on failure.

DigitalAccessController::show. Requires digital-access.view. Returns the grant's safe fields (status, access_mode, issued_at, activated_at, expires_at, revoked_at, revocation_reason, failure_reason). An ACTIVE grant past its check_out is lazily transitioned to EXPIRED on read (§11 'Access validity is re-checked server-side at every access attempt'). data.credential (the PIN) is present ONLY while status is active; a not_issued / failed / revoked / expired grant never carries it. When no grant exists yet the response is a transient 'not_issued' payload (HTTP 200), never a 404.

header.description: local/testing only: success | failure. A provider failure still revokes locally.

request.description: DigitalAccessController::revoke -> DigitalAccessService::revoke. Requires digital-access.revoke. Staged: DB txn (ACTIVE -> REVOKE_REQUESTED) -> provider revoke OUTSIDE any txn -> DB txn (REVOKE_REQUESTED -> REVOKED, credential nulled). Local revocation is authoritative - a provider failure still results in REVOKED and is audited with requires_reconciliation. Repeated revoke is a safe no-op (already-revoked / expired grant returns 200 unchanged). The reservation is NOT rolled back - it stays CHECKED_IN. Body: optional short 'reason' (max 500). 422 = nothing to revoke (no credential was ever issued / grant is FAILED). Rate limited (throttle:digital-access.revoke).

item.name: 12 Checkout & Invoice
item.description: Phase 9 — Checkout + Final Settlement + Invoice. POST /api/v1/reservations/{reservation}/checkout, GET /api/v1/reservations/{reservation}/invoice (Phase 0 §12/§16). {reservation} is an int id resolved through ReservationService, so a cross-hotel or missing id is an identical plain 404. Permissions checkout.perform / invoice.view — Group Owner, assigned Hotel Manager, assigned Reception (Phase 0 §7: Reception performs the operational one-tap checkout, every checkout audited); Guest-role users resolve out of scope (404). The client sends NO amount — the settlement amount is always computed server-side from the folio. When outstanding_total > 0 the payment provider is called for a final settlement OUTSIDE any DB transaction; on failure/pending the reservation stays CHECKOUT_IN_PROGRESS and no invoice is issued (business rule: never CHECKED_OUT / INVOICED on a failed/pending settlement). Idempotency-Key is shared with the settlement PaymentTransaction. Rate limited (throttle:checkout.perform). X-Payment-Simulate is honoured ONLY in local/testing.

request.description: outstanding_total <= 0 => no provider call: reservation CHECKOUT_IN_PROGRESS -> CHECKED_OUT -> INVOICED via ReservationService, invoice ISSUED. 200 with the checkout resource.

InvoiceController::show. invoice.view permission. Issued invoice with frozen line items snapshotted from the posted folio charges + totals. 404 before checkout. No payment secret / provider reference / card data.
Guest-role token: no checkout.perform, no hotel assignment -> reservation does not resolve -> plain 404.
Manager acting on a reservation in an unassigned hotel -> identical plain 404. Hotel scope resolved server-side from the reservation, never a client hotel_id.
Checkout may only begin from IN_STAY (or resume from CHECKOUT_IN_PROGRESS / CHECKED_OUT). Any other status -> 422 CheckoutNotAllowedException, nothing persisted.
